summary: Control rain, snow and lightning to grow plants and reshape nature for kids
description:
THE LITTLE CLOUD THAT CHANGES THE WORLD!
Become Kumo, a little cloud full of magic! The world is waiting for you: make it rain, create snow, summon lightning, and bring the landscape back to life.

The world is grey and sad… but thanks to you, its colors return! Grow trees, create snowy mountains, break rocks with lightning, and watch nature transform with every gentle gesture.

Pango Kumo invites children to discover weather and the water cycle through play. They observe, experiment, and immediately see the effects of their actions: rain, snow, evaporation, plant growth, landscape transformation. A simple and intuitive way to understand nature, perfect from age 3.

A PANGO CREATION
For over 15 years, Pango has been creating smart, accessible, and caring experiences, enjoyed by more than 15 million children worldwide. With Pango Kumo, your child explores nature, understands weather phenomena, and plays with the elements in a joyful universe.

WHY DO PARENTS LOVE PANGO KUMO?
- Introduces the water cycle in a simple and playful way
- Encourages free exploration and natural curiosity
- Develops fine motor skills and observation
- Interactive world: rain, snow, lightning, evaporation, vegetation
- No stress, no challenges, no time limits
- A vast world that changes with every play session
- Perfect for children aged 3 and up

A 100% SAFE GAME FOR KIDS
• No in-app purchases
• No ads
• No external links
• Built-in parental controls
• Compliant with children’s data protection standards

PANGO VALUES: NATURE, LEARNING, DISCOVERY
At Pango, we create games designed to encourage curiosity and help children understand the world. Simple, caring, and calming experiences that support every child at their own pace.

DOWNLOAD PANGO KUMO and let your child play with the weather: MAKE IT RAIN, MAKE IT SNOW… AND WATCH LIFE GROW!
